title: Photographer Invoice Template
subtitle: An invoice pre-filled for photography work — session, extra hours, edited photos, prints, travel and albums. Download as Excel (auto-calculating), Word, or PDF.
taxHint: Look up your state's sales tax rate
paymentTerms: Net 7 — payment due within 7 days. A 50% retainer is required to book the shoot date.

features: Auto-calculating tax formulas in Excel (just enter your state rate)
Pre-filled photography line items: session, extra hours, edited photos, prints, travel, album
Net 7 + 50% retainer terms standard for creative work
Per-photo and per-hour lines make quote-to-invoice matching easy

faqs.q: What should I include on a photographer invoice?
faqs.a: At minimum: your business name, the client and shoot location, a dated line-item list (session fee, extra hours, edited photos, prints, travel), tax, and a total due. Itemize per-photo and per-hour charges so the final bill matches the quote.

faqs.q: Is this template free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All three formats (PDF, Word, Excel) are free to download with no email required.

faqs.q: Does the Excel version calculate tax automatically?
faqs.a: Yes. Enter your quantity and rate per line, and the subtotal, tax and total update automatically. Leave the tax rate blank if you are not required to charge sales tax.

faqs.q: Is this legal or tax advice?
faqs.a: No. Templates are for informational purposes only. Requirements vary by state — verify with your tax authority and a CPA or attorney before use.
